generate_dyadic_cor.Rd

Generate data from correlated dyadic CFA population model.

Usage

generate_dyadic_cor(dvn, lvname, pop_values, n_dyads, seed = NULL)

Arguments

pop_values

List with loadings_p1, loadings_p2, residuals_p1, residuals_p2, coresids, lv_cov.

n_dyads

Number of dyads.

seed

Integer seed.
